name: Sainte-Foy-Bordeaux

limits: For red wine, main grapes together: at least 85%
For red wine, Carmenère: at most 10%
For white wine, main grapes together: at least 85%
rules.yield_base: 50 hl/ha for red, 60 for dry white, 45 for medium-sweet white, 37 for sweet white

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation in Entre-Deux-Mers for red and white wine, with whites made dry, medium-sweet or sweet. Reds use Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Malbec, and whites Sémillon, Sauvignon Blanc, Sauvignon Gris and Muscadelle.

sources.name: Candiago et al. 2022, A geospatial inventory of regulatory information for wine protected designations of origin in Europe, Scientific Data (product specifications as of 2021)
